Images · 100% Private Client-Side

Photo Timeline Builder

Sort photos by file date and generate a standalone offline HTML photo album. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Sorts collections of photographs by file modification timestamps and compiles them into a standalone, portable HTML chronological album. Generates an offline gallery timeline that can be archived, emailed, or opened in any browser without needing third-party photo software.

How to use

  1. Drop a folder or batch of photo files from a family event, wedding, or vacation trip.
  2. The timeline builder automatically orders them chronologically by file timestamp metadata.
  3. Preview the structured chronological event list and picture order on your screen.
  4. Download photo-timeline.html to preserve your standalone offline photo diary.

Limits & Considerations

Reads file system lastModified timestamps. Does not extract EXIF GPS coordinate metadata, camera lens models, or facial recognition tags.

Privacy & Security

Album generation runs entirely in client-side JavaScript. Your personal photo libraries and event memories remain completely confidential.
